metadata.name: NowNest
metadata.subtitle: Park ideas. Return to now.
metadata.description: NowNest is a quiet, offline-first space for holding your current next action when a new idea appears. Keep one project, outcome, and next action visible. Park an interruption locally, confirm it is tucked away, and return to NOW. Review parked ideas later. No account, network connection, analytics, notifications, or cloud backup.

review_information.setup_notes: NowNest is a single-screen offline app. Launch it and you will see your NOW context (project, outcome, next action). Tap Park to park a new idea. Tap Actions to review parked ideas or edit NOW. No login or network access is required. The app works immediately on first launch.
